app.title: The Little Hole
sound.unavailable: No voice on this device. The words stay on screen.
fallback.webgl: This device can't run the moving simulation. Here are still pictures: they show the same thing.
chapter.wow.title: Look closely
chapter.wow.say.open: The world came inside the box. Upside down!
chapter.straight-light.title: Light goes straight
chapter.straight-light.say: Move the lamp. The rays stay perfectly straight.
chapter.straight-light.say.blocked: Your hand stops the rays. Behind it: a shadow.
chapter.no-hole.title: No hole, no picture
chapter.no-hole.say: Open the window wide. Look at the wall.
chapter.no-hole.say.wide: Every point sends light everywhere. No picture left!
chapter.no-hole.say.narrow: The smaller the window, the more you can see.
chapter.the-hole.title: The little hole sorts the light
chapter.the-hole.say: Close the window down to a tiny hole.
chapter.the-hole.say.sorted: Every point found its own place on the wall.
chapter.upside-down.title: Why it's upside down
chapter.upside-down.say: Lift the little person. The picture goes down.
chapter.upside-down.say.crossed: The rays cross inside the hole. That's why.
chapter.upside-down.sideView: From the side: top and bottom swap
chapter.upside-down.topView: From above: left and right swap too
chapter.hole-size.title: Big hole or little hole?
chapter.hole-size.say: Change the size of the hole. Watch the picture.
chapter.hole-size.say.big: Big hole: nice and bright, but all blurry.
chapter.hole-size.say.best: There! That's as sharp as it can be.
chapter.hole-size.say.small: Too tiny: the light spreads out and blurs again.
chapter.hole-size.darkAdaptHelp: Like when you stay in the dark for a while.
chapter.box-length.title: Short box or long box
chapter.box-length.say: Make the box longer. The picture grows.
chapter.box-length.say.long: Bigger, but darker: the light spreads out.
chapter.your-eye.title: Your eye is a dark box
chapter.your-eye.say: Your pupil is the hole. The back of your eye is the wall.
chapter.your-eye.say.dark: In the dark, your pupil opens wide to catch more light.
chapter.your-eye.brain: Your brain turns the picture the right way up. All by itself.
chapter.sun-spots.title: Sun spots on the ground
chapter.sun-spots.say: Look at the ground, under the tree.
chapter.sun-spots.say.eclipse: The Moon bites the Sun. The spots turn into crescents!
chapter.sun-spots.eclipse: The Moon moves in front of the Sun
chapter.sun-spots.leaves: Between the leaves: lots of little holes.
chapter.build-it.title: Build your own
chapter.build-it.say: You need a box, some paper and a needle.
chapter.build-it.step.1: Cut a square at one end of the box.
chapter.build-it.step.2: Tape kitchen foil over the square.
chapter.build-it.step.3: Prick one tiny hole in the middle with the needle.
chapter.build-it.step.4: At the other end, cut a window. Tape tracing paper on it.
chapter.build-it.step.5: Close the box. Tape every edge: no light gets in!
chapter.build-it.step.6: Go outside, point the hole at a house. Watch the paper.
chapter.build-it.tip: Tip: put a cloth over your head. It gets even darker.
chapter.build-it.grownup: For the grown-up: the scissors and the needle are your job.
